newsitem.title: UK: Moody's declines comment on Israel rating report.
newsitem.headline: Moody's declines comment on Israel rating report.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday it had no comment on an earlier report, later denied by the Bank of Israel, that the rating agency had warned Israeli officials of a possible cut in Israel's sovereign credit rating.
The Bank of Israel earlier on Tuesday denied a newspaper report it had received a letter from Moody's warning of a possible lowering of its sovereign credit rating.
"Israel is not even on watch and beyond that we have no comment," said a spokesman for Moody's in London, adding that the agency does not send such letters.
A report in the Maariv daily said government officials feared Israel's credit rating would be reduced because of widening deficits in the budget and the balance of payments current account.
The newspaper cited a report in a fax newsletter that circulates among traders that Moody's had sent a warning to the central bank.
Israel is rated A3 by Moody's and A minus by Standard & Poor's.
